name: What is the difference between a primary suite addition and a remodel?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between a primary suite addition and a remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: A primary suite addition involves expanding the physical footprint of your home to create new space, whereas a remodel alters an existing space without increasing its size. For example, converting an unused attic into a primary bedroom is an addition, while updating an existing primary bedroom and bathroom within their current walls is a remodel. Additions typically involve more extensive structural work, permitting, and a longer construction timeline due to creating new foundations and framing.
acceptedAnswer.description: An addition expands your home's footprint to create new space, while a remodel updates an existing space without increasing its size.
